{"type":"assistant","message":{"model":"claude-haiku-5-5","id":"msg_011CgCqqrkzozV5bvhi9wz9w","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"text","text":"=== BEGIN ARTIFACT FEATURE-ATOMIC-COMMANDS.md ===\n# FEATURE: Atomic Commands\n\n| Field       | Value |\n|-------------|-------|\n| Version     | 20261020 V1 |\n| Description | Every ledger command runs as one database transaction that commits in full or changes nothing. |\n| Depends On  | DATABASE.md, FEATURE-LEDGER-ENTRY.md, FEATURE-SCHEMA-INIT.md, FEATURE-DATABASE-SELECTION.md, FEATURE-EXIT-CODES.md, FEATURE-TEST-RUNNER.md |\n\n## Questions\n\n- None.\n\n## Purpose\n\nWraps every command handler in a single transaction through the generated persistence layer. A\ncommand that fails for any reason rolls back, leaving every table as it was. A transfer stores both\nof its rows or neither. Concurrent commands each commit or fail as a single unit.\n\nWriter serialization follows the persistence library's default transaction behavior (decision\nQ-002). No application-level retry loop is added.\n\n## Database Interface\n\n- `FEATURE-TXN-001` — write: create a transaction in the same transaction as the command - supplies: `txn_id`, `date`, `account`, `category`, `amount`, `memo` - returns: `txn_id`, `date`, `account`, `category`, `amount`, `memo`\n- `FEATURE-TXN-005` — write: delete a transaction within the command's transaction - supplies: `txn_id` - returns: `deleted`\n\n## Programmatic Acceptance\n\n=== AC atomic-rejected-post-changes-nothing ===\nIntent: A post rejected for an unknown account leaves every table exactly as it was.\n\nimport os\nimport tempfile\nfrom cli.testing import cli_runner\n\nwork = tempfile.mkdtemp()\nos.environ[\"DATABASE_URL\"] = os.path.join(work, \"ledger.db\")\ncategories = os.path.join(work, \"categories.csv\")\nwith open(categories, \"w\") as handle:\n    handle.write(\"category,description\\nSALES,Sales receipts\\n\")\n\nassert cli_runner(\"init\")[0] == 0\nassert cli_runner(\"account\", \"add\", \"CASH1\", \"Cash Box\")[0] == 0\nassert cli_runner(\"load\", \"categories\", categories)[0] == 0\nbefore = cli_runner(\"count\")[1]\ncode, out, err = cli_runner(\"txn\", \"post\", \"NOSUCH\", \"SALES\", \"1.00\", \"2026-01-02\")\nassert code == 3\nassert cli_runner(\"txn\", \"get\", \"1\")[0] == 4\nassert cli_runner(\"count\")[1] == before\n=== END AC atomic-rejected-post-changes-nothing ===\n\n=== AC atomic-rejected-transfer-changes-nothing ===\nIntent: A transfer rejected for identical accounts, a non-positive amount, or an unknown account stores neither row.\n\nimport os\nimport tempfile\nfrom cli.testing import cli_runner\n\nwork = tempfile.mkdtemp()\nos.environ[\"DATABASE_URL\"] = os.path.join(work, \"ledger.db\")\ncategories = os.path.join(work, \"categories.csv\")\nwith open(categories, \"w\") as handle:\n    handle.write(\"category,description\\nSALES,Sales receipts\\n\")\n\nassert cli_runner(\"init\")[0] == 0\nassert cli_runner(\"account\", \"add\", \"CASH1\", \"Cash Box\")[0] == 0\nassert cli_runner(\"account\", \"add\", \"CASH2\", \"Second Box\")[0] == 0\nassert cli_runner(\"load\", \"categories\", categories)[0] == 0\nbefore = cli_runner(\"count\")[1]\nassert cli_runner(\"transfer\", \"CASH1\", \"CASH1\", \"5.00\", \"2026-01-02\")[0] == 3\nassert cli_runner(\"transfer\", \"CASH1\", \"CASH2\", \"-1.00\", \"2026-01-02\")[0] == 3\nassert cli_runner(\"transfer\", \"CASH1\", \"NOSUCH\", \"5.00\", \"2026-01-02\")[0] == 3\nassert cli_runner(\"count\")[1] == before\nassert cli_runner(\"txn\", \"get\", \"1\")[0] == 4\n=== END AC atomic-rejected-transfer-changes-nothing ===\n\n=== AC atomic-transfer-stores-both-rows ===\nIntent: A successful transfer stores exactly its two legs under consecutive ids, outgoing first.\n\nimport os\nimport tempfile\nfrom cli.testing import cli_runner\n\nwork = tempfile.mkdtemp()\nos.environ[\"DATABASE_URL\"] = os.path.join(work, \"ledger.db\")\ncategories = os.path.join(work, \"categories.csv\")\nwith open(categories, \"w\") as handle:\n    handle.write(\"category,description\\nSALES,Sales receipts\\n\")\n\nlegs = 2\nfirst_id = 2\namount_text = \"5.00\"\n\nassert cli_runner(\"init\")[0] == 0\nassert cli_runner(\"account\", \"add\", \"CASH1\", \"Cash Box\")[0] == 0\nassert cli_runner(\"account\", \"add\", \"CASH2\", \"Second Box\")[0] == 0\nassert cli_runner(\"load\", \"categories\", categories)[0] == 0\nassert cli_runner(\"txn\", \"post\", \"CASH1\", \"SALES\", \"10.00\", \"2026-01-01\")[0] == 0\n\ncode, out, err = cli_runner(\"transfer\", \"CASH1\", \"CASH2\", amount_text, \"2026-01-02\")\nassert code == 0\nrows = out.splitlines()[1:]\nassert len(rows) == legs\nids = [row.split(\",\")[0] for row in rows]\nassert ids == [str(first_id), str(first_id + 1)]\nassert cli_runner(\"txn\", \"get\", str(first_id))[0] == 0\nassert cli_runner(\"txn\", \"get\", str(first_id + 1))[0] == 0\n=== END AC atomic-transfer-stores-both-rows ===\n\n=== AC atomic-concurrent-commands ===\nIntent: Two or more concurrent ledger processes each commit or fail as a single unit, so the stored row count equals the number of successful exits.\n\nimport os\nimport subprocess\nimport tempfile\nfrom cli.testing import cli_runner\n\nwork = tempfile.mkdtemp()\ndatabase = os.path.join(work, \"ledger.db\")\nos.environ[\"DATABASE_URL\"] = database\ncategories = os.path.join(work, \"categories.csv\")\nwith open(categories, \"w\") as handle:\n    handle.write(\"category,description\\nSALES,Sales receipts\\n\")\n\nassert cli_runner(\"init\")[0] == 0\nassert cli_runner(\"account\", \"add\", \"CASH1\", \"Cash Box\")[0] == 0\nassert cli_runner(\"load\", \"categories\", categories)[0] == 0\n\nenv = {**os.environ, \"DATABASE_URL\": database}\nledger = os.path.join(os.getcwd(), \"ledger\")\nattempts = 4\nprocs = [\n    subprocess.Popen(\n        [ledger, \"txn\", \"post\", \"CASH1\", \"SALES\", \"1.00\", \"2026-01-02\"],\n        stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.PIPE, text=True, env=env,\n    )\n    for _ in range(attempts)\n]\nresults = [proc.communicate() for proc in procs]\ncodes = [proc.returncode for proc in procs]\nfor (out, err), code in zip(results, codes):\n    print(code, err)\n\nassert all(code in (0, 1, 3) for code in codes)\ntransaction_rows = int(cli_runner(\"count\")[1].splitlines()[3].split(\",\")[1])\nassert transaction_rows == codes.count(0)\n=== END AC atomic-concurrent-commands ===\n\n## User Acceptance\n\n- None.\n\n## Guardrails\n\n- No command handler opens a database driver directly; every write goes through `db.<table>.<verb>(...)`.\n- A command never commits a partial result, including on an exception path.\n- Writes are never retried by application code to mask a conflict.\n\n=== END ARTIFACT ===\n=== BEGIN ARTIFACT FEATURE-NONNEGATIVE-BALANCE.md ===\n# FEATURE: Non-Negative Balance\n\n| Field       | Value |\n|-------------|-------|\n| Version     | 20261020 V1 |\n| Description | Rejects any command that would leave an account balance below zero, checked before commit. |\n| Depends On  | FEATURE-ATOMIC-COMMANDS.md, FEATURE-AMOUNT-CENTS.md, FEATURE-EXIT-CODES.md, DATABASE.md |\n\n## Questions\n\n- None.\n\n## Purpose\n\nAfter a command's changes and before commit, sums each account's transaction amounts in integer\ncents. Any account whose balance is below zero causes the command to roll back and exit 3. Balance\nis the sum of transaction amounts; a balance of exactly zero is allowed.\n\n## Database Interface\n\n- `FEATURE-TXN-001` — write: post a transaction whose balance is checked before commit - supplies: `txn_id`, `date`, `account`, `category`, `amount`, `memo` - returns: `txn_id`, `date`, `account`, `category`, `amount`, `memo`\n- `FEATURE-TXN-004` — write: amend a transaction amount whose balance is checked before commit - supplies: `txn_id`, `amount` - returns: `txn_id`, `date`, `account`, `category`, `amount`, `memo`\n- `FEATURE-TXN-003` — read: read every transaction to compute account balances - supplies: none - returns: `account`, `amount`\n\n## Programmatic Acceptance\n\n=== AC balance-overdraft-post-rejected ===\nIntent: A post that would leave an account below zero exits 3 and stores nothing.\n\nimport os\nimport tempfile\nfrom cli.testing import cli_runner\n\nwork = tempfile.mkdtemp()\nos.environ[\"DATABASE_URL\"] = os.path.join(work, \"ledger.db\")\ncategories = os.path.join(work, \"categories.csv\")\nwith open(categories, \"w\") as handle:\n    handle.write(\"category,description\\nSALES,Sales receipts\\n\")\n\nassert cli_runner(\"init\")[0] == 0\nassert cli_runner(\"account\", \"add\", \"CASH1\", \"Cash Box\")[0] == 0\nassert cli_runner(\"load\", \"categories\", categories)[0] == 0\nassert cli_runner(\"txn\", \"post\", \"CASH1\", \"SALES\", \"10.00\", \"2026-01-01\")[0] == 0\nbefore = cli_runner(\"count\")[1]\nassert cli_runner(\"txn\", \"post\", \"CASH1\", \"SALES\", \"-10.01\", \"2026-01-02\")[0] == 3\nassert cli_runner(\"txn\", \"get\", \"2\")[0] == 4\nassert cli_runner(\"count\")[1] == before\n=== END AC balance-overdraft-post-rejected ===\n\n=== AC balance-overdraft-amend-rejected ===\nIntent: An amend that would leave an account below zero exits 3 and leaves the stored amount unchanged.\n\nimport os\nimport tempfile\nfrom cli.testing import cli_runner\n\nwork = tempfile.mkdtemp()\nos.environ[\"DATABASE_URL\"] = os.path.join(work, \"ledger.db\")\ncategories = os.path.join(work, \"categories.csv\")\nwith open(categories, \"w\") as handle:\n    handle.write(\"category,description\\nSALES,Sales receipts\\n\")\namount_text = \"10.00\"\n\nassert cli_runner(\"init\")[0] == 0\nassert cli_runner(\"account\", \"add\", \"CASH1\", \"Cash Box\")[0] == 0\nassert cli_runner(\"load\", \"categories\", categories)[0] == 0\nassert cli_runner(\"txn\", \"post\", \"CASH1\", \"SALES\", amount_text, \"2026-01-01\")[0] == 0\nassert cli_runner(\"txn\", \"amend\", \"1\", \"-1.00\")[0] == 3\nrow = cli_runner(\"txn\", \"get\", \"1\")[1].splitlines()[1]\nassert row.split(\",\")[4] == amount_text\n=== END AC balance-overdraft-amend-rejected ===\n\n=== AC balance-overdraft-delete-rejected cli_runner(\"load\", \"categories\", categories)[0] == 0\nassert cli_runner(\"txn\", \"post\", \"CASH1\", \"SALES\", \"10.00\", \"2026-01-01\")[0] == 0\nassert cli_runner(\"txn\", \"post\", \"CASH1\", \"SALES\", \"-4.00\", \"2026-01-02\")[0] == 0\nassert cli_runner(\"txn\", \"delete\", \"1\")[0] == 3\nassert cli_runner(\"txn\", \"get\", \"1\")[0] == 0\n=== END AC balance-overdraft-delete-rejected ===\n\n=== AC balance-overdraft-transfer-rejected ===\nIntent: A transfer that would leave its from-account below zero exits 3 and stores neither row.\n\nimport os\nimport tempfile\nfrom cli.testing ===\n\n=== AC balance-zero-accepted ===\nIntent: A command that leaves an account balance of exactly zero succeeds.\n\nimport os\nimport tempfile\nfrom cli.testing import cli_runner\n\nwork = tempfile.mkdtemp()\nos.environ[\"DATABASE_URL\"] = os.path.join(work, \"ledger.db\")\ncategories = os.path.join(work, \"categories.csv\")\nwith open(categories, \"w\") as handle:\n \"SALES\", \"-10.00\", \"2026-01-02\")[0] == 0\nassert cli_runner(\"txn\", \"get\", \"2\")[0] == 0\n=== END AC balance-zero-accepted ===\n\n## User Acceptance\n\n- None.\n\n## Guardrails\n\n- Balances Output is `table,loaded` then\n`accounts,<rows>`. os.path.join(work, \"accounts.csv\")\nwith open(accounts, \"w\") as handle:\n    handle.write(\"account,name\\nDRAWER1,Front Drawer\\nSAFE,Store Safe\\n\")\nrow_count = 2\n\nassert cli_runner(\"init\")[0] == 0\ncode, out, err = cli_runner(\"load\", \"accounts\", accounts)\nassert code == 0\nlines = out.splitlines()\nassert lines[0] == \"table,loaded\"\nassert lines[1].split(\",\") == [\"accounts\", str(row_count)]\nassert cli_runner(\"count\")[1].splitlines()[1].split(\",\") == [\"accounts\", str(row_count)]\n=== END AC load-accounts-valid-file ===\n\n=== BEGIN ARTIFACT FEATURE-ATOMIC-COMMANDS.md ===\n# FEATURE: Atomic Commands\n\n| Field       | Value |\n|-------------|-------|\n| Version     | 20261020 V1 |\n| Description | Every ledger command runs as one database transaction that commits in full or changes nothing. |\n| Depends On  | DATABASE.md, FEATURE-LEDGER-ENTRY.md, FEATURE-SCHEMA-INIT.md, FEATURE-DATABASE-SELECTION.md, FEATURE-EXIT-CODES.md, FEATURE-TEST-RUNNER.md |\n\n## Questions\n\n- None.\n\n## Purpose\n\nWraps every command handler in a single transaction through the generated persistence layer. A\ncommand that fails for any reason rolls back, leaving every table as it was. A transfer stores both\nof its rows or neither. Concurrent commands each commit or fail as a single unit.\n\nWriter serialization follows the persistence library's default transaction behavior (decision\nQ-002). No application-level retry loop is added.\n\n## Database Interface\n\n- `FEATURE-TXN-001` — write: create a transaction in the same transaction as the command - supplies: `txn_id`, `date`, `account`, `category`, `amount`, `memo` - returns: `txn_id`, `date`, `account`, `category`, `amount`, `memo`\n- `FEATURE-TXN-005` — write: delete a transaction within the command's transaction - supplies: `txn_id` - returns: `deleted`\n\n## Programmatic Acceptance\n\n=== AC atomic-rejected-post-changes-nothing ===\nIntent: A post rejected for an unknown account leaves every table exactly as it was.\n\nimport os\nimport tempfile\nfrom cli.testing import cli_runner\n\nwork = tempfile.mkdtemp()\nos.environ[\"DATABASE_URL\"] = os.path.join(work, \"ledger.db\")\ncategories = os.path.join(work, \"categories.csv\")\nwith open(categories, \"w\") as handle:\n    handle.write(\"category,description\\nSALES,Sales receipts\\n\")\n\nassert cli_runner(\"init\")[0] == 0\nassert cli_runner(\"account\", \"add\", \"CASH1\", \"Cash Box\")[0] == 0\nassert cli_runner(\"load\", \"categories\", categories)[0] == 0\nbefore = cli_runner(\"count\")[1]\ncode, out, err = cli_runner(\"txn\", \"post\", \"NOSUCH\", \"SALES\", \"1.00\", \"2026-01-02\")\nassert code == 3\nassert cli_runner(\"txn\", \"get\", \"1\")[0] == 4\nassert cli_runner(\"count\")[1] == before\n=== END AC atomic-rejected-post-changes-nothing ===\n\n=== AC atomic-rejected-transfer-changes-nothing ===\nIntent: A transfer rejected for identical accounts, a non-positive amount, or an unknown account stores neither row.\n\nimport os\nimport tempfile\nfrom cli.testing import cli_runner\n\nwork = tempfile.mkdtemp()\nos.environ[\"DATABASE_URL\"] = os.path.join(work, \"ledger.db\")\ncategories = os.path.join(work, \"categories.csv\")\nwith open(categories, \"w\") as handle:\n    handle.write(\"category,description\\nSALES,Sales receipts\\n\")\n\nassert cli_runner(\"init\")[0] == 0\nassert cli_runner(\"account\", \"add\", \"CASH1\", \"Cash Box\")[0] == 0\nassert cli_runner(\"account\", \"add\", \"CASH2\", \"Second Box\")[0] == 0\nassert cli_runner(\"load\", \"categories\", categories)[0] == 0\nbefore = cli_runner(\"count\")[1]\nassert cli_runner(\"transfer\", \"CASH1\", \"CASH1\", \"5.00\", \"2026-01-02\")[0] == 3\nassert cli_runner(\"transfer\", \"CASH1\", \"CASH2\", \"-1.00\", \"2026-01-02\")[0] == 3\nassert cli_runner(\"transfer\", \"CASH1\", \"NOSUCH\", \"5.00\", \"2026-01-02\")[0] == 3\nassert cli_runner(\"count\")[1] == before\nassert cli_runner(\"txn\", \"get\", \"1\")[0] == 4\n=== END AC atomic-rejected-transfer-changes-nothing ===\n\n=== AC atomic-transfer-stores-both-rows ===\nIntent: A successful transfer stores exactly its two legs under consecutive ids, outgoing first.\n\nimport os\nimport tempfile\nfrom cli.testing import cli_runner\n\nwork = tempfile.mkdtemp()\nos.environ[\"DATABASE_URL\"] = os.path.join(work, \"ledger.db\")\ncategories = os.path.join(work, \"categories.csv\")\nwith open(categories, \"w\") as handle:\n    handle.write(\"category,description\\nSALES,Sales receipts\\n\")\n\nlegs = 2\nfirst_id = 2\namount_text = \"5.00\"\n\nassert cli_runner(\"init\")[0] == 0\nassert cli_runner(\"account\", \"add\", \"CASH1\", \"Cash Box\")[0] == 0\nassert cli_runner(\"account\", \"add\", \"CASH2\", \"Second Box\")[0] == 0\nassert cli_runner(\"load\", \"categories\", categories)[0] == 0\nassert cli_runner(\"txn\", \"post\", \"CASH1\", \"SALES\", \"10.00\", \"2026-01-01\")[0] == 0\n\ncode, out, err = cli_runner(\"transfer\", \"CASH1\", \"CASH2\", amount_text, \"2026-01-02\")\nassert code == 0\nrows = out.splitlines()[1:]\nassert len(rows) == legs\nids = [row.split(\",\")[0] for row in rows]\nassert ids == [str(first_id), str(first_id + 1)]\nassert cli_runner(\"txn\", \"get\", str(first_id))[0] == 0\nassert cli_runner(\"txn\", \"get\", str(first_id + 1))[0] == 0\n=== END AC atomic-transfer-stores-both-rows ===\n\n=== AC atomic-concurrent-commands ===\nIntent: Two or more concurrent ledger processes each commit or fail as a single unit, so the stored row count equals the number of successful exits.\n\nimport os\nimport subprocess\nimport tempfile\nfrom cli.testing import cli_runner\n\nwork = tempfile.mkdtemp()\ndatabase = os.path.join(work, \"ledger.db\")\nos.environ[\"DATABASE_URL\"] = database\ncategories = os.path.join(work, \"categories.csv\")\nwith open(categories, \"w\") as handle:\n    handle.write(\"category,description\\nSALES,Sales receipts\\n\")\n\nassert cli_runner(\"init\")[0] == 0\nassert cli_runner(\"account\", \"add\", \"CASH1\", \"Cash Box\")[0] == 0\nassert cli_runner(\"load\", \"categories\", categories)[0] == 0\n\nenv = {**os.environ, \"DATABASE_URL\": database}\nledger = os.path.join(os.getcwd(), \"ledger\")\nattempts = 4\nprocs = [\n    subprocess.Popen(\n        [ledger, \"txn\", \"post\", \"CASH1\", \"SALES\", \"1.00\", \"2026-01-02\"],\n        stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.PIPE, text=True, env=env,\n    )\n    for _ in range(attempts)\n]\nresults = [proc.communicate() for proc in procs]\ncodes = [proc.returncode for proc in procs]\nfor (out, err), code in zip(results, codes):\n    print(code, err)\n\nassert all(code in (0, 1, 3) for code in codes)\ntransaction_rows = int(cli_runner(\"count\")[1].splitlines()[3].split(\",\")[1])\nassert transaction_rows == codes.count(0)\n=== END AC atomic-concurrent-commands ===\n\n## User Acceptance\n\n- None.\n\n## Guardrails\n\n- No command handler opens a database driver directly; every write goes through `db.<table>.<verb>(...)`.\n- A command never commits a partial result, including on an exception path.\n- Writes are never retried by application code to mask a conflict.\n\n=== END ARTIFACT ===\n=== BEGIN ARTIFACT FEATURE-NONNEGATIVE-BALANCE.md ===\n# FEATURE: Non-Negative Balance\n\n| Field       | Value |\n|-------------|-------|\n| Version     | 20261020 V1 |\n| Description | Rejects any command that would leave an account balance below zero, checked before commit. |\n| Depends On  | FEATURE-ATOMIC-COMMANDS.md, FEATURE-AMOUNT-CENTS.md, FEATURE-EXIT-CODES.md, DATABASE.md |\n\n## Questions\n\n- None.\n\n## Purpose\n\nAfter a command's changes and before commit, sums each account's transaction amounts in integer\ncents. Any account whose balance is below zero causes the command to roll back and exit 3. Balance\nis the sum of transaction amounts; a balance of exactly zero is allowed.\n\n## Database Interface\n\n- `FEATURE-TXN-001` — write: post a transaction whose balance is checked before commit - supplies: `txn_id`, `date`, `account`, `category`, `amount`, `memo` - returns: `txn_id`, `date`, `account`, `category`, `amount`, `memo`\n- `FEATURE-TXN-004` — write: amend a transaction amount whose balance is checked before commit - supplies: `txn_id`, `amount` - returns: `txn_id`, `date`, `account`, `category`, `amount`, `memo`\n- `FEATURE-TXN-003` — read: read every transaction to compute account balances - supplies: none - returns: `account`, `amount`\n\n## Programmatic Acceptance\n\n=== AC balance-overdraft-post-rejected ===\nIntent: A post that would leave an account below zero exits 3 and stores nothing.\n\nimport os\nimport tempfile\nfrom cli.testing import cli_runner\n\nwork = tempfile.mkdtemp()\nos.environ[\"DATABASE_URL\"] = os.path.join(work, \"ledger.db\")\ncategories = os.path.join(work, \"categories.csv\")\nwith open(categories, \"w\") as handle:\n    handle.write(\"category,description\\nSALES,Sales receipts\\n\")\n\nassert cli_runner(\"init\")[0] == 0\nassert cli_runner(\"account\", \"add\", \"CASH1\", \"Cash Box\")[0] == 0\nassert cli_runner(\"load\", \"categories\", categories)[0] == 0\nassert cli_runner(\"txn\", \"post\", \"CASH1\", \"SALES\", \"10.00\", \"2026-01-01\")[0] == 0\nbefore = cli_runner(\"count\")[1]\nassert cli_runner(\"txn\", \"post\", \"CASH1\", \"SALES\", \"-10.01\", \"2026-01-02\")[0] == 3\nassert cli_runner(\"txn\", \"get\", \"2\")[0] == 4\nassert cli_runner(\"count\")[1] == before\n=== END AC balance-overdraft-post-rejected ===\n\n=== AC balance-overdraft-amend-rejected ===\nIntent: An amend that would leave an account below zero exits 3 and leaves the stored amount unchanged.\n\nimport os\nimport tempfile\nfrom cli.testing import cli_runner\n\nwork = tempfile.mkdtemp()\nos.environ[\"DATABASE_URL\"] = os.path.join(work, \"ledger.db\")\ncategories = os.path.join(work, \"categories.csv\")\nwith open(categories, \"w\") as handle:\n    handle.write(\"category,description\\nSALES,Sales receipts\\n\")\namount_text = \"10.00\"\n\nassert cli_runner(\"init\")[0] == 0\nassert cli_runner(\"account\", \"add\", \"CASH1\", \"Cash Box\")[0] == 0\nassert cli_runner(\"load\", \"categories\", categories)[0] == 0\nassert cli_runner(\"txn\", \"post\", \"CASH1\", \"SALES\", amount_text, \"2026-01-01\")[0] == 0\nassert cli_runner(\"txn\", \"amend\", \"1\", \"-1.00\")[0] == 3\nrow = cli_runner(\"txn\", \"get\", \"1\")[1].splitlines()[1]\nassert row.split(\",\")[4] == amount_text\n=== END AC balance-overdraft-amend-rejected ===\n\n=== AC balance-overdraft-delete-rejected BEGIN ARTIFACT FEATURE-LOAD-ACCOUNTS.md ===\n# FEATURE: Load Accounts\n\n| Field       | Value |\n|-------------|-------|\n| Version     | 20261020 V1 |\n| Description | Loads accounts from a CSV file, validating every row before commit. |\n| Depends On  | FEATURE-NONNEGATIVE-BALANCE.md, FEATURE-VALIDATE-CODE.md, FEATURE-VALIDATE-TEXT.md, FEATURE-EXIT-CODES.md, FEATURE-TEST-RUNNER.md, DATABASE.md |\n| Provides    | ledger load accounts <csv> |\n\n## Questions\n\n- None.\n\n## Purpose\n\n`ledger load accounts <csv>` reads a file whose header is `account,name`, validates each row's\ncode and name, and inserts every row in one transaction. Output is `table,loaded` then\n`accounts,<rows>`. A row that fails validation or duplicates an existing key rejects the whole\nfile with exit 3.\n\n## Database Interface\n\n- `FEATURE-ACCOUNT-001` — write: create an account from a loaded row - supplies: `account`, `name` - returns: `account`, `name`\n\n## Programmatic Acceptance\n\n=== AC load-accounts-valid-file ===\nIntent: A valid accounts file loads every row and writes table,loaded then accounts,<rows>.\n\nimport os\nimport tempfile\nfrom cli.testing import cli_runner\n\nwork = tempfile.mkdtemp()\nos.environ[\"DATABASE_URL\"] = os.path.join(work, \"ledger.db\")\naccounts = os.path.join(work, \"accounts.csv\")\nwith open(accounts, \"w\") as handle:\n    handle.write(\"account,name\\nDRAWER1,Front Drawer\\nSAFE,Store Safe\\n\")\nrow_count = 2\n\nassert cli_runner(\"init\")[0] == 0\ncode, out, err = cli_runner(\"load\", \"accounts\", accounts)\nassert code == 0\nlines = out.splitlines()\nassert lines[0] == \"table,loaded\"\nassert lines[1].split(\",\") == [\"accounts\", str(row_count)]\nassert cli_runner(\"count\")[1].splitlines()[1].split(\",\") == [\"accounts\", str(row_count)]\n=== END AC load-accounts-valid-file ===\n\n=== AC load-accounts-rows-readable ===\nIntent: Each loaded account reads back through account get with the name it was loaded with.\n\nimport os\nimport tempfile\nfrom cli.testing import cli_runner\n\nwork = tempfile.mkdtemp()\nos.environ[\"DATABASE_URL\"] = os.path.join(work, \"ledger.db\")\naccounts = os.path.join(work, \"accounts.csv\")\nwith open(accounts, \"w\") as handle:\n    handle.write(\"account,name\\nDRAWER1,Front Drawer\\n\")\ncode_text = \"DRAWER1\"\nname_text = \"Front Drawer\"\n\nassert cli_runner(\"init\")[0] == 0\nassert cli_runner(\"load\", \"accounts\", accounts)[0] == 0\ncode, out, err = cli_runner(\"account\", \"get\", code_text)\nassert code == 0\nrow = out.splitlines()[1].split(\",\")\nassert row[0] == code_text\nassert row[1] == name_text\n===
